protocol.byteDefinition: CDP received network bytes including reported overhead; failed/unfinished transfers remain explicitly unresolved
protocol.scope: Main CDP session; service workers blocked; child-frame coverage incomplete; no network interception or request blocking
protocol.phaseMeaning: Cumulative totals in one context; deltas are additional bytes since the preceding checkpoint, not independent page loads

overallScore.label: Scoped WSG audit score
overallScore.formula: 100 * passed / (passed + failed + cantTell), grouped once per guideline

impactWeighted.status: Experimental project convention using WSG impact priority points; not a W3C site score

overallScore.interpretation: Passes satisfy only the declared scoped expectations; unknowns earn no points but are not defects. Compare only matching rubric, sample, and evidence profiles.
